scope: Six lesson specifications, module-level staging adapter, lesson-specific visual renderers and isolated progress model

checks.evidence: All six JSON specifications contain 17 screens and the shared sequence Situation, Model, Example, Practice, Check, Result. Previous local harness validated 102 unique screen IDs.
business-architecture-learning-module.js passed node --check and resolves M01L01-M01L06 through the module manifest.
Dedicated renderers exist for system_map, flow_map, management_cycle, causal_loop, gate_board and version_lifecycle.
Normal mode unlocks lessons sequentially; admin/review mode can inspect all lessons through ba_learning_unlock=all.
Micro-check and final quiz block progression until an answer is selected, then display the explanation before continuing.
Each lesson requires at least four micro-practice fields before the learner can continue.
Each lesson stores independent learningFlow state under architecture_business_progress_v2 / lessons.<lessonId>.learningFlow. Existing course progress fields are preserved.
The adapter calls the existing BusinessArchitecture.syncNow() after local persistence. Supabase and Telegram acceptance are not claimed.
The module assembles six artefacts around one object and explicitly allows STOP as a correct business decision when a critical gate is red.

Main business-architecture.js, business-architecture.css, catalog.json, Supabase endpoint and production user data were not replaced. New files are loaded only on the draft branch and activated by preview/admin mode.
Blank and filled XLSX workbooks exist as completed local artefacts. The staging manifest intentionally keeps download URLs empty until a durable binary delivery location is connected.
Requires deployment of the draft branch and manual acceptance in Telegram WebApp on iPhone and Android.
Requires a real Telegram session, save/reload on another device and conflict-merge verification against the existing endpoint.

limitations: Static and syntax verification does not replace browser acceptance inside the real Telegram WebApp.
Practice XLSX buttons remain disabled until the two binary assets receive durable URLs.
The draft branch contains the complete six-lesson staging route but does not replace the production BA catalogue.
The existing standalone M01L01 adapter remains for legacy prototype review; the new module route uses ba_learning_preview=m01.
